transcript: Never try to remove those white stones from your throat with your finger or a cotton swab. In Chinese medicine, we have always known that if you force them out without cleaning, what causes them, they come back twice as big. If you have bad breath that never goes away, no matter what you use. If you feel something stuck in the back of your throat. If you have ever had a white chunk come out that smells like nothing you have ever experienced, those are tonsil stones. Millions of people have them and have no idea what they really are. Western medicine has one answer, surgery. Remove the tonsils and problem solved. But it is not because the tonsils are not the problem. They are where the body pushes what it cannot clean. In Chinese medicine, this is dampness and heat rising from a gut that is not working properly. This is what you need to do every morning before anything else. Warm water, one teaspoon of sea salt, and one teaspoon of unfiltered apple cider vinegar. Goggle for 30 seconds, reach the back of the throat. The stones begin to loosen on their own. The breath starts to clear. The throat finally gets a chance to clean itself without being forced, but they keep coming back. And the question is why? Because the gut sends them up. Until the gut is fixed, the throat keeps collecting what the body cannot process. And the gut does not get damaged only by what you eat. It gets damaged by how you live. Stress inflames the walls of the intestine. Anxiety slows digestion down. The emotions you swallow every day without releasing stay inside rotting. And your body pushes them upward because they need to come out somewhere. Your throat is carrying what your gut cannot process, and your gut is carrying what you never release. Write in the comments, clean from within. If this made sense to you, and if you want to learn how to cleanse your body from where it all begins, to calm what inflames your gut, and to release what has been building up inside of you, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
